summary: Fairbanks Police reported an arrest early Thursday, on a disorderly conduct charge. No new criminal case was filed in any of the four Interior courts — Fairbanks, Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction — between Wednesday evening and Thursday morning. Troopers reported two Interior items late on Wednesday: a criminal trespass summons issued at Healy for an offense on Oct. 30, and an assault reported at Delta Junction on Tuesday that remains under investigation. A domestic violence assault arrest made at Delta Junction on June 29 is reported here for the first time. Fairbanks Police also reported one arrest for Wednesday, on a charge of violating a domestic violence protective order. Eight open cases carry a hearing on Thursday, among them a jury trial continuing at the Delta Junction courthouse; ten other hearings set for Thursday had already been vacated. The court's weekly criminal filings report covers Oct. 29 to Nov. 4 and lists 38 cases filed at Fairbanks, four at Nenana, two at Delta Junction and none at Healy; those are the report's own counts for its own window, and this week they match every Fairbanks case number the court's public database serves. Two of the Delta Junction numbers the report lists still return no record in that database. The court's weekly report of cases disposed has not been updated since Nov. 2, so no court outcome later than that date can be reported.

entries.title: Disorderly conduct arrest: Jenell M. Semaken
body: Jenell M. Semaken, 43, was arrested on a charge of disorderly conduct, recorded by police as creating a hazardous condition and as a misdemeanor.
2200 block of South Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 5 at 1:55 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Fairbanks Police, case 26003375. No court case has been opened on this arrest.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Aaliyah Koenig
body: Aaliyah Koenig was arrested on a charge of domestic violence assault — assaulting a household member.

Delta Junction, June 29; Alaska State Troopers. Troopers say they received a report of a domestic violence assault after the fact, that the investigation determined she injured a household member, and that she was arrested and remanded at the Fairbanks Correctional Center, held without bail.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26061734. Court case 4DJ-26-00068CR at Delta Junction.

entries.title: Criminal trespass summons: Rachel Hancock
body: Rachel Hancock, 26, of Healy was issued a summons on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining unlawfully on premises — recorded by troopers as a misdemeanor.

A Healy gas station, Oct. 30 at 9:39 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers. Troopers say they received a report of trespassing at the gas station that evening and identified her as the suspect, that they could not locate her that day, and that they contacted her on Nov. 4 and issued the summons.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26107313. No court case has been opened on this charge.

entries.title: Protective order violation arrest: Jerome Benjamin Semaken
body: Jerome Benjamin Semaken, 42, was arrested on a charge of violating a domestic violence protective order — doing something a protective order forbids — recorded by police as a misdemeanor.
2500 block of Mercier Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 4 at 2:29 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Fairbanks Police, case 26003367. No court case has been opened on this arrest.

entries.title: Assault reported in Delta Junction
body: Troopers say they received a report of an assault at Delta Junction on Nov. 3 at about 1:08 p.m. and that the investigation is continuing.
The dispatch names no one, states no charge and records no arrest.

entries.title: Eight Interior criminal cases carry a hearing on Thursday; ten other hearings set for the same day were vacated
body: Eight open criminal cases in the Fairbanks and Delta Junction courts carry a hearing calendared for Thursday, Nov. 5. A jury trial in a 2024 Delta Junction case, 4DJ-24-00006CR, is set for 8:30 a.m. at the Delta Junction courthouse, after a trial day at the Fairbanks courthouse on Wednesday.

Pre-trial conferences are set for 8:30 a.m. in 4FA-26-02078CR and 4FA-26-01852CR, and two bail hearings at the same hour in 4FA-26-01826CR, one of which is already recorded as continued. Omnibus hearings of the Superior Court are set for 2:30 p.m. in 4FA-26-01896CR and 4DJ-26-00060CR, and preliminary hearings for 3:15 p.m. in 4FA-26-02117CR and 4FA-26-02098CR.

Ten further hearing slots on Thursday are already recorded as vacated, six of them preliminary hearings in the same 3:15 p.m. slot. No new criminal case was filed in any of the four Interior courts between Wednesday evening and early Thursday.
